message_1_subject: Annual committed spend invoicing / drawdown calendar + VAT questions
message_1_body:
Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the productive call. Per our conversation, attached is a proposed billing calendar for the $1.2M annual commitment and a simple drawdown tracker so BrightCart can monitor remaining credits by month (file: 2026_invoice_schedule.xlsx).

Two quick questions we need from you to finalize the invoice:
1) Confirm billing entity and exact legal name for the invoice header (needed for EU VAT handling).
2) Do you require a separate VAT number on each monthly drawdown invoice or a single yearly invoice with monthly line items? We typically issue a single prepay invoice and provide monthly drawdown statements; for EU customers we can either show VAT or apply reverse-charge depending on your VAT registration.

If you prefer, we can issue the full prepay invoice now (Net 30) and push monthly drawdown statements for your records. Marissa (cc) will share a sample SOW invoice template and the DocuSign link for the prepay SOW.

Next steps:
- Please confirm legal billing name + VAT number (if applicable) by EOD Friday.
- If PO is required, send the PO number to billing@redwoodinference.com so we can reference it on the invoice.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if useful.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
